Any settings/plugin/hook loading therefore depends on external/default Claude Code resolution not bound by this caller's source-level invocation receipt.

semantic_atoms.what_it_does: hooks/hooks.json declares a PreToolUse matcher for all tools routed to scripts/stern.py hook, while its own description explicitly classifies this path as fail-silent and exit-0-always.
Realtime function_call call_id is retained in _offene_tool_calls and passed into _tool_ausfuehren for completed responses.

Although _tool_ausfuehren receives call_id, the frank_auftrag_stellen branch invokes _auftrag_stellen_mit_bestaetigung(args) without call_id. The confirmation state binds normalized task text, time and transcript count; on success it calls self.auftrag.stellen(auftrag_text), whose background bridge forwards text to _claude_taetigkeit. No immutable Realtime call_id/task-admission identity is carried into claude_frage.
semantic_atoms.failure_mode: Two distinct or overlapping confirmed task invocations can enter the delegation layer without a source-level one-to-one lineage from provider call_id through task admission, background job, headless invocation and downstream effect receipt.

architecture_delta.before: Voice confirmation, an explicit Bash deny, historical settings inheritance and a repository hook declaration existed as separate safety mechanisms, while current Triggerword-5 frontier already required exact host/plugin/settings proof and invocation-bound effect identity.
architecture_delta.after: For Frankenstein 2.0, the delegation boundary is now explicitly decomposed into three independently evidenced layers: (1) VoiceProposal/TaskAdmission bound to Realtime call_id + task digest + session/causal/generation evidence, (2) HeadlessDelegationCapsule binding exact executable/source/settings/plugin/hook identities plus cwd/session/tool policy, and (3) one-shot pre-side-effect EffectDecision/CapabilityLease with typed outcome receipt. Historical hooks and Bash denial remain defense-in-depth donors, not canonical effect authority.
